title: unify-sdks-auth-retries-streaming-parity-v1.195.0
author: Sofia Rios
release_notes: SDKs: unify auth + retries + streaming ergonomics; Python v1.195.0, TS v1.195.0, Go v1.195.0. Fixes token refresh race, aligned streaming event shapes, improved retry/backoff defaults. Backwards-compatible with minor behavior changes in stream event ordering documented.
description: Context: This PR unifies recent parallel changes to auth, retry semantics, and streaming APIs across the Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs as part of the v1.195.0 release. Motivation: service teams and customers reported inconsistent token refresh behavior (leading to 401s under burst load), mismatched streaming event shapes between SDKs, and divergent retry/backoff defaults across languages which made multi-lang client behavior unpredictable. This changeset: 1) Centralizes auth token refresh semantics: add singleflight-style refresh to prevent thundering herd, ensure preemptive refresh at 90% TTL, and standardize error handling for transient auth errors. 2) Implements a shared retry/backoff policy: default to exponential backoff with jitter, default max attempts = 4, retry on idempotent network errors and 429/503 by default. 3) Streaming parity and ergonomics: unify the streaming event envelope used by SDKs (event types: data, done, error, heartbeat, reconnect), add small-API ergonomic helpers for TypeScript/Go to decode events, and make Python streaming iterator yield consistent tuples (event_type, payload, meta). 4) Version bumps: Python -> v1.195.0, TS -> v1.195.0, Go -> v1.195.0 and associated changelogs. Checklist: - [x] Design doc reviewed (ENG-3124) - [x] Cross-language tests added / harness updated - [x] CI green (after flaky streaming fix) - [x] Release notes drafted - [x] Performance regression check (latency p50/p95 unchanged) - [x] Security review for auth changes Commits summary: consolidated auth token singleflight (py/ts/go), added retry policy module and tests, streaming envelope refactor + compatibility shim, version bumps and changelogs, small README updates. Testing notes: Local integration tests run against canary inference cluster. Streaming end-to-end tests were flaky initially due to ordering assumptions; fixed by adding event sequencing metadata and a heartbeat test. Backward compatibility: streaming payload shape is additive (clients should continue to work), but ordering of heartbeat events is now stable; release notes document behavioral notes for edge cases.

notes_for_release: This release standardizes auth and retry behavior across all official SDKs and stabilizes streaming event shapes. Operators should monitor for increased token refresh traffic on initial rollout due to TTL skew; the preemptive refresh is conservative but diagnostic info is included in logs. No breaking changes expected for typical clients; check docs/releases/v1.195.0.md for migration notes.
